literal_meaning: তাড়া করে তর্জন করা (চার্জ করে ধমকানো)
figurative_meaning_en: Chasing or pursuing someone while scolding or threatening them
similar_in_english: give someone a piece of one's mind while chasing
example_sentences_in_bangla: মা তেড়েমেড়ে ছেলেকে বাড়ি থেকে তাড়িয়ে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He chased the thief hotly, scolding him all the way.
The mother drove the boy out of the house, pursuing him with angry words.
history: This idiom is famously used in Sukumar Ray's nonsense verse: 'তেড়ে মেড়ে দাণ্ডা করে দিই ঠাণ্ডা', highlighting playful yet vivid Bengali expressions.
note: Originating from colloquial Bengali, often in humorous or satirical contexts in literature.
